purpose: Prototype/demo dataset for testing outbreak-alert retrieval and chatbot responses.
important_notice: The records below are DEMONSTRATION DATA and must not be presented to users as real current outbreaks. A production system should consume and verify official surveillance data before issuing an alert.

official_surveillance_sources.name: Integrated Disease Surveillance Programme (IDSP), NCDC, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
official_surveillance_sources.role: National disease surveillance and outbreak monitoring

official_surveillance_sources.name: Integrated Health Information Platform (IHIP) — IDSP
official_surveillance_sources.role: Government health information and disease-surveillance platform

official_surveillance_sources.name: IHIP Community Based Surveillance
official_surveillance_sources.role: Community reporting of outbreak-prone diseases and related events

alert_levels.ELEVATED: Increased activity requiring additional awareness and preventive measures.
alert_levels.HIGH: High-priority alert requiring users to follow official public-health guidance and seek care when appropriate.

alerts.message: Demo alert: increased dengue activity detected in the area.
precautions: Use mosquito repellent and protective clothing.
Remove stagnant water where mosquitoes can breed.
alerts.chatbot_response_hint: Tell the user that this is an elevated demo alert and provide general dengue-prevention advice. Do not claim that a real outbreak is occurring.

alerts.message: Demo alert: increased malaria activity detected in the area.
precautions: Use mosquito nets and repellents where appropriate.
Seek medical evaluation promptly if malaria is suspected.
alerts.chatbot_response_hint: Provide malaria-prevention information and advise medical evaluation for suspected malaria. Do not diagnose the user.

alerts.message: Demo alert: increased chikungunya activity detected in the area.
alerts.chatbot_response_hint: Provide mosquito-bite prevention guidance and advise medical care for severe or persistent symptoms.

alerts.message: Demo alert: measles activity requiring heightened awareness.
precautions: Follow the recommended measles vaccination schedule.
Avoid close contact with people suspected to have measles.
Seek medical advice if fever and a widespread rash occur.
alerts.chatbot_response_hint: Emphasize vaccination and medical evaluation for suspected measles. Do not confirm infection from symptoms alone.

precautions: Wash hands regularly with soap and water.
Follow safe food and sanitation practices.
Seek urgent medical care for severe diarrhoea or signs of dehydration.
alerts.chatbot_response_hint: Prioritize dehydration warnings and urgent medical evaluation when severe diarrhoea is reported.

production_data_flow.step_1: Retrieve outbreak/event information from an authorised government surveillance source such as IDSP/IHIP.
production_data_flow.step_2: Verify the disease, location, date, alert status, and source.
production_data_flow.step_3: Store only verified records in the production database.
production_data_flow.step_4: Match the alert against the user's requested location.
production_data_flow.step_5: Return the alert together with prevention guidance and the official source.
production_data_flow.step_6: Never generate or infer an outbreak solely from an LLM.

safety_rules: Never present DEMO records as real outbreaks.
Do not create an outbreak alert from unverified social-media or user claims.
Always display the source and last-updated date for real alerts.
If no verified alert exists for a location, say that no verified alert was found rather than saying there is no outbreak.
The chatbot must not diagnose disease based on an outbreak alert or symptoms.
critical_safety_notes: All records in this prototype are DEMONSTRATION DATA and must not be presented as real current outbreaks.
Never infer an outbreak from symptoms, social-media claims, or user reports alone.
Real alerts must have a verified official source and update date.
If no verified alert is found, say that no verified alert was found; do not claim that no outbreak exists.
An outbreak alert is not a diagnosis.
response_restrictions: Only use records marked VERIFIED for real-world alerts.
If data_status is DEMO, explicitly tell the user it is demonstration data.
Do not fabricate case counts, alert levels, dates, or locations.
Do not convert a disease-information record into an outbreak alert.
For real alerts, include the source and last-updated date.
For emergency symptoms, prioritize medical-care guidance over outbreak information.
